modos.descricao: Ver Combat Action do oponente antes de selecionar a propria (Gn5)

params.descricao: Ve a Combat Action do oponente antes de selecionar a sua; deve jogar uma Combat Action por round. Descarta apos 3 rounds.

_metadata.texto_original: The Gift user may see her opponents Combat Action before it is played and select her own Combat Action once her opponents has been seen. The Gift user must play a Combat Action during each round of combat. Discard this Gift after 3 rounds of combat have passed.
